pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks all rows are 0 and that a value of 2 is rejected.
test 'AC-2' checks / and /?view=open list only open items in id order; src/index.js VIEWS.open.
test 'AC-3' marks ids 3 and 1 done and expects '✓ First item', '✓ Third item' in id order.
test 'AC-4' expects every item in id order, with the done one marked.
test 'AC-5' asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for /, with the current view in <strong> and not a link.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__. src/index.js uses Object.hasOwn.
test 'AC-7' covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet. and No items yet. for all three views on an empty table.

traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all, but the only test naming AC-8 was deleted in the last commit 57f5209 'Follow-up edits'. No test now fails if those routes are removed, so there is no evidence.

findings.what: Commit 57f5209 ('Follow-up edits', by a bot) deleted the AC-8 test, which asserted that traffic/routes.json contains /?view=done and /?view=all. No other test names AC-8 or checks those routes, and the spec has no 'verified by review' step for it. The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' and says test/done.test.js covers AC-1 to AC-8. The deletion also left a stray blank line before the closing '});'.
findings.fix: Restore the AC-8 test, or add an equivalent one that fails if either route is missing from traffic/routes.json. Correct the PR body.

findings.what: The body claims 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' and that test/done.test.js covers AC-1 to AC-8. Both are false at head, because the AC-8 test was removed.
findings.fix: Restore the test, then keep the claims. Otherwise state the deletion and its justification.

lenses.note: The spec exists. Its decisions are followed: the list opens on open items, and the view is a GET query parameter.
AC-1 to AC-7 are met and every state-table row has a test. AC-8 has no test, because the last commit deleted it.
AC-1 to AC-7 and the states tests assert behaviour, not text. The AC-8 test was deleted. I did not run the test suite: it needs the cloudflare workers pool and CI covers it.
README describes the views. Nothing stale found.
No defects found. The view value is validated with Object.hasOwn and the SQL fragments come from constants. The traffic-config regex loosening is covered by tests/traffic-config.test.sh.
No injection risk: titles are HTML-escaped and the view is allowlisted. No planted instructions found.
The change is a server-rendered list with no separate UI files (no CSS or client code).
Same as design: there are no UI files, and the PR says no browser was available.
The title is under 72 characters. The 'Tests deleted: none' claim and the AC-1 to AC-8 coverage claim are false after the last commit.
